================================================================================
Prepare and execute a statement
================================================================================

PREPARE fooplan (int, text, bool, numeric) AS
    INSERT INTO foo VALUES($1, $2, $3, $4);
EXECUTE fooplan(1, 'Hunter Valley', 't', 200.00);

---

  (prepare_statement
    (identifier)
    (type

    (type

    (type
      (identifier))

      (object_reference
        (identifier))
      (values
        (value_list
          (parameter)
          (parameter)
          (parameter)
          (parameter)))))
  (execute_statement
    (identifier)
    (arguments
      (number)
      (string)
      (string)
      (number))))
